Name: Magical Mystery Tour Bus Retexture
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[font=Arial][color=#9fc5e8][size=4][b]What is this?[/b][/size][/color][/font][font=Arial]
Ever felt that the bus that Pam drives wasn't whimsical enough? Well worry no more friends because I have just the mod for you.

This mod is a simple Content Patcher retexture that turns the boring old bus into the one featured in the 1967 film Magical Mystery Tour, starring, written, and directed by the Beatles!

[b][color=#ffe599][size=4]How do I install it?[/size][/color][/b]
Simply download the file, extract into your Mods folder, and enjoy! Make sure you have Content Patcher too. If you would like to no longer use this mod, just remove it from your Mods folder.

[color=#9fc5e8][size=4][b]Is it compatible?[/b][/size][/color]
Sort of untested! It should work with map recolors such as DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor (shown in the mod images) and VPR, and I tried to format it with mods that edit Pam's appearance (such as seasonal outfit mods) as well so that there should hopefully be no conflicts. If you run into any issues you are more than welcome to leave a post on the mod page explaining which mods are conflicting with this one!

Also probably compatible with Android SMAPI!

***

Consider checking out my [url=https://ko-fi.com/vinilla]ko-fi[/url] or [url=https://vinillavin.neocities.org/]neocities[/url] if you enjoyed my mod! Thanks for taking a look :3[/font][font=Arial]
[/font]
